questions.text: Describe a machine learning model you've built from scratch. Walk me through your approach from problem definition to deployment.

follow_up_suggestions.text: Can you be more specific about the problem you were solving and the data involved?
How did you evaluate your model and handle overfitting/underfitting?

scoring_rubric.1: Cannot describe a relevant ML project
scoring_rubric.2: Describes a project but with significant gaps in approach
scoring_rubric.3: Describes a project with reasonable ML engineering practices
scoring_rubric.4: Demonstrates strong understanding of ML pipeline
scoring_rubric.5: Exceptional understanding with sophisticated ML engineering

questions.text: How do you approach feature engineering? Can you give an example of how you created features for a past project?

follow_up_suggestions.text: Can you describe the specific features you created and why they were important?

scoring_rubric.3: Good understanding of feature engineering principles
scoring_rubric.4: Strong feature engineering with domain knowledge
scoring_rubric.5: Expert understanding with sophisticated feature creation

questions.text: Tell me about your experience with data analysis and exploratory data analysis (EDA). What's your typical EDA process?

follow_up_suggestions.text: How do you handle missing values and outliers in your EDA?

scoring_rubric.2: Basic EDA knowledge but missing systematic approach
scoring_rubric.5: Expert EDA with sophisticated analysis techniques

questions.text: How do you approach communicating your findings and results to non-technical stakeholders?

follow_up_suggestions.text: Can you give a specific example of a complex finding you had to communicate?

scoring_rubric.2: Basic ability but often too technical
scoring_rubric.3: Good ability to simplify complex concepts
scoring_rubric.5: Exceptional ability to translate technical findings
